eval: (() => { const r = game.engine.renderer.info; return { calls: r.render.calls, tris: r.render.triangles, geos: r.memory.geometries, prog: r.programs.length }; })()
label: renderer (spawn)

eval: (() => { const s = game.atmosphere.sunDir; game.player.yaw = Math.atan2(-s.x, -s.z); game.player.pitch = 0.05; return 'sol'; })()
(() => { const s = game.atmosphere.sunDir; game.player.yaw = Math.atan2(s.x, s.z); game.player.pitch = -0.05; return 'costas p/ sol'; })()
(() => { const s = game.atmosphere.sunDir; game.player.yaw = Math.atan2(-s.z, s.x); game.player.pitch = 0.0; return 'lateral'; })()

(() => { const b = game.biome; let best = null; for (let r = 40; r < 600 && !best; r += 20) for (let a = 0; a < 6.28; a += 0.3) { const x = Math.cos(a) * r, z = Math.sin(a) * r; if (b.forest(x, z) < 0.02 && b.forest(x + 25, z) < 0.3) { best = [x, z]; break; } } const p = game.player; p.position.set(best[0], game.terrain.heightAt(best[0], best[1]), best[1]); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); game.chunks.warmup(p.position); p.yaw = 1.2; p.pitch = 0; return best.map(v => +v.toFixed(0)); })()
label: clareira

eval: (() => { const b = game.biome; let best = null; for (let r = 40; r < 600 && !best; r += 20) for (let a = 0; a < 6.28; a += 0.3) { const x = Math.cos(a) * r, z = Math.sin(a) * r; if (b.forest(x, z) > 0.98) { best = [x, z]; break; } } const p = game.player; p.position.set(best[0], game.terrain.heightAt(best[0], best[1]), best[1]); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); game.chunks.warmup(p.position); game.chunks.resolveCollision(p.position, 0.35); p.yaw = 2.5; p.pitch = 0.05; return best.map(v => +v.toFixed(0)); })()
label: mata fechada

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, inp = g.input; p.spawn(0, 0, 0); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); g.chunks.resolveCollision(p.position, 0.35); const p0 = p.position.clone(); inp.down.add('KeyW'); inp.down.add('ShiftLeft'); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) p.update(1 / 30); inp.down.clear(); return { moved: +p0.distanceTo(p.position).toFixed(2), speed: +Math.hypot(p.velocity.x, p.velocity.z).toFixed(2) }; })()
label: corrida simulada 2 s

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player; p.position.set(3000, 0, -2000); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); const a = { ...g.chunks.stats }; p.position.set(-5000, 0, 7000); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); const b = { ...g.chunks.stats }; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { p.position.x += 64; g.chunks.update(p.position, Infinity); } g.engine.render(); return { a, b, depois: g.chunks.stats, geos: g.engine.renderer.info.memory.geometries }; })()
label: teleportes + streaming

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, inp = g.input; const ch = [...g.chunks.loaded.values()].find(c => c.lod === 0 && c.colliders.length > 0); const c = ch.colliders; const tx = c[0], tz = c[1], r = c[2]; p.position.set(tx + r + 2.5, g.terrain.heightAt(tx + r + 2.5, tz), tz); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = Math.PI / 2; p.pitch = 0; inp.down.add('KeyW'); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) p.update(1 / 30); inp.down.clear(); const d = Math.hypot(p.position.x - tx, p.position.z - tz); return { dist: +d.toFixed(3), minimo: +(r + 0.35).toFixed(3), ok: d >= r + 0.35 - 0.01 }; })()
label: colisão com tronco

eval: (() => { const g = game, cm = g.chunks; const ch = [...cm.loaded.values()].find(c => !c.grass); const owner = [...cm.loaded.values()].find(c => c.grass); const ocx = ch.cx, ocz = ch.cz; const t = (fn, n) => { const s = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) fn(i); return +((performance.now() - s) / n).toFixed(2); }; const res = { terrainMs: t(i => g.terrain.fillChunkGeometry(ch.ground.geometry, 500 + i, 500), 10), populateMs: t(i => { ch.place(600 + i, 600); g.vegetation.populate(ch); }, 10), grassMs: t(() => g.vegetation.fillGrass(owner.grass, owner), 5), grassCount: owner.grass.count }; ch.place(ocx, ocz); g.terrain.fillChunkGeometry(ch.ground.geometry, ocx, ocz); g.vegetation.populate(ch); return res; })()
